dialogueLines.hi: Beta, jyot toh jal rahi hai — par saare diye bujhe pade hain. Utsav kaise shuru ho?
dialogueLines.en: Child, the eternal flame is burning — but all the lamps sit unlit. How can the festival begin?

dialogueLines.hi: Har tyohar ek yaad hai, Aru — use roshan rakhna hamara kaam hai!
dialogueLines.en: Every festival is a memory, Aru — keeping it glowing is our job!
